# NT Runtime Automation

Collect runtime evidence or maintain helpers in `ai_studio/runtime_automation/`.

## Load Only What Applies

- `references/runtime-workflow-rules.md`: launch/reuse rhythm, evidence paths,
  native-first proof, and boundaries for game-specific smoke scripts.
- `references/devapi-pattern.md`: DevAPI discovery, command metadata, UI/input,
  frame sync, and capture flow.
- `references/visual-qa-checklist.md`: only when the task asks for visible
  runtime evidence; quality acceptance rules live in `ai_studio/quality/`.
- [Game video capture](../../../.codex/skills/nt-runtime-automation/references/game-video-capture.md): native audiovisual
  recording, decoded-media checks, and draft/master acceptance.

## Collect Evidence

Use the game's runbook for launch/reuse and the DevAPI port. Discover
`endpoints` and describe unfamiliar commands; live registration is the contract.
Choose shared helpers from `ai_studio/runtime_automation/README.md` as needed.

Use observe -> act -> `frame.wait` -> observe. Wrap interactive injection
(`ui.click`, `input.*`) in `DevApiClient.player_gated()` so a live mouse does not
put synthetic input in a non-primary slot. Capture after the state is stable.
Inspect screenshots and relevant runtime state before claiming the behavior.
Report evidence paths, failures, and coverage gaps.

## Boundaries

- Runtime Automation owns local proof helpers, not engine DevAPI internals.
- Games own semantic commands and game-specific smoke scenarios.
- `ai_studio/quality/` owns acceptance rules such as player clarity or technical
  behavior evidence.
- `ai_studio/taskboard/` owns durable task state.
- Keep release builds automation-free unless the project explicitly changes that
  policy.

## Helper Maintenance

When changing shared helpers, follow their module contract and run targeted
tests while editing. At handoff, run the runtime owner check below; run the
architecture-map check when module ownership or registered paths change.
Collecting evidence with unchanged helpers does not require these owner checks.

```powershell
node ai_studio/studio.mjs verify --domain runtime
node ai_studio/architecture_map/validate_map.mjs
```
